ACCESS2_POLICY_EXPRESSION_EVAL
Description
This event is triggered when per-request policy branch expressions are
evaluated.
Examples
when
ACCESS2_POLICY_EXPRESSION_EVAL
{
set
access2_proc
[
ACCESS2
::
access2_proc
]
set
ret
[catch
{
call
$access2_proc
}
my_result
]
return
-
code
$ret
$my_result
}
